note: magicui.design — Magic UI's registry. The 96 url-less typed items are all examples of a component (magic-card-demo-2, striped-pattern-dashed, marquee-3d, text-animate-…, noise-texture-demo-2, …; slug is null, the id suffix is the name). Each component's docs page /docs/components/<component> shows its examples (checked: bento-grid carries bento-demo/-demo-vertical, magic-card etc.), so the rewrite strips the example suffix — one rule, longest page name first, over the 77 /docs/components pages of the sitemap — and fills docs/components/<page> into the url. bento-demo(-vertical) has no page prefix of its own and is shown on /docs/components/bento-grid (explicit rule). All 96 items fill. robots.txt: / and /docs allowed (only /api/, /_next/, /public/ disallowed).
